reason: Moses is not mentioned in this text at all. The passage (Exodus 1:6-12) describes the death of Joseph and his generation, the rise of a new Pharaoh in Egypt who does not know Joseph, and the subsequent oppression of the Israelites through forced labor and task masters. This account predates Moses' introduction in the biblical narrative, which does not occur until Exodus 2. Therefore, Moses cannot be portrayed in any capacity in this text.
